aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:873.title: Fall Intern, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:873.description: Fall Intern, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary: AEG Internship Program offers a real-world experience that allows college students to learn the business of sports and live entertainment. In the Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Department, interns have a unique opportunity to work alongside a team that creates a safe and inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, can express their authentic selves, and shares a strong sense of belonging regardless of race, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or ability. Responsibilities: Support Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) programs and Employee Network Group (ENG) initiatives that foster inclusive and engaging employee experience. Assist with maintaining and auditing DEI and ENG resources, including company intranet pages, SharePoint sites, and communication channels. Research, propose, and support employee engagement campaigns, including volunteer hour tracking and recognition programs for Employee Network Groups. Help develop and execute internal communications, content calendars, and awareness campaigns for cultural observances, and DEI initiatives Complete administrative tasks Collect data from the Employee Network Group events Attend ENG planning meetings to assist with coordinating programming Assist with sourcing, vetting, and curating specific content for diverse subjects requested by various AEG Departments The AEG Internship Program requires a minimum commitment of 18 hours per week during the fall. Qualifications: Passion for sports and live entertainment Currently pursuing a degree in a relevant field Excellent written and verbal communication skills Fluent in Microsoft Office – EXCEL, WORD, and PowerPoint specifically Ability to multi-task and work well under pressure Intern Perks Corporate networking Resume review with AEG Talent Acquisition team Pay rate: $19.00-$21.00 Location: Los Angeles (On-site) Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. Benefits: Part-time: This position is not eligible for benefits. AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside their normal description. AEG's policy is to hire the most qualified applicants, and we comply with all applicable federal, state and local employment laws in making hiring and employee decisions. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, marital status, disability, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected status recognized by applicable federal, state or local law. crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:98.description: Come join our team at DIS-TRAN Steel! Our people – not our machinery - are our biggest assets. DIS-TRAN Steel’s leadership team lives by our company values, modeling our culture of respect and integrity each day. We're a team that likes to have fun, but we also know how to get stuff done. DIS-TRAN Steel is looking to hire a Maintenance Technician to join the team in Pineville, LA. DIS-TRAN Steel is looking for a Maintenance Technician to join the team in Pineville, LA. The Maintenance Technician I must be capable of performing industrial maintenance. This individual should be knowledgeable of maintenance related duties. The Maintenance Technician I is required to have a background in working with hydraulic and electrical equipment. Experience with software, CNC, and PLC is considered a plus for this position. This individual must be able to communicate well within an industrial culture.
responsibilities: Monitors and maintains production equipment with or without direct supervision.
Can troubleshoot and repair minor equipment malfunctions on (noncritical) machines.
Disassembles machine prior to maintenance work.
Reassembles machines after the completion of repair or maintenance work.
Starts machines and observes mechanical operation to determine efficiency and to detect problems.
Inspects or tests damaged machine parts, and marks defective areas or advises supervisors of repair needs.
Lubricates or applies adhesives or other materials to machines, machine parts, or other equipment, according to specified procedures.
Installs, replaces, or changes machine parts and attachments, according to manufacturer specifications on (noncritical) machines.
Dismantles machines and removes parts for repair, using specified tools.
Records production, repair, and machine maintenance information.
Reads work orders and specifications to determine machines and equipment requiring repair or maintenance.
Collaborates with other workers to repair or move machines, machine parts, or equipment.
Performs scheduled preventative maintenance.
Ability to repair tools and small engines
qualifications: High School Diploma or equivalent preferred.
Ability to interpret blueprints required.
Ability to read a tape measure required.
2 + years of prior industrial maintenance experience required.
Hydraulic and electrical background experience required.
Communication in an industrial environment required.
Experience with software, CNC, and PLC is considered a plus.
Regular, reliable attendance is required.

foundersfactory-founders-factory:ashbyhq.title: Talent Investor - Venture Studio
foundersfactory-founders-factory:ashbyhq.description: ABOUT FOUNDERS FACTORY: Founders Factory is a venture studio and accelerator. We build technology companies from scratch, working with leading corporate partners to identify opportunities, develop new products and businesses, and build the founding teams that turn them into independent companies. Unlike a traditional VC, we don't just invest in companies that already exist. We help create them. That means our approach to talent is different too. We believe the right founder can fundamentally change the trajectory of a company. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Talent Investor, you'll sit at the intersection of venture, talent and company building, helping us identify the exceptional people who will build our next generation of companies. Our ventures often start with a problem or opportunity, rather than a founder. Your job is to find the person who can turn that opportunity into an excellent business. You'll work closely with our Venture Builders, Studio Leads and founders to: - Identify exceptional founders across our global network and beyond. - Build talent maps and develop a point of view on where the best founders and operators sit. - Assess individuals for founder-market fit, looking beyond CVs and conventional credentials to understand their potential to build a company. - Build relationships with exceptional people who aren't necessarily looking for their next role. - Convince them to take the leap into entrepreneurship and build with Founders Factory. - Help founders identify and recruit their early founding team across product, technology, commercial and growth. - Develop our approach to founder sourcing, assessment and talent intelligence as we build more ventures. This isn't traditional recruitment. You won't be given a list of vacancies to fill. You'll be given venture theses and asked to work out who could build them. You'll have significant autonomy to experiment with how we identify, assess and attract exceptional people, and your work will directly influence the quality and trajectory of the companies we build. ABOUT YOU At your core, you're obsessed with exceptional people and curious about how great companies are built. You might come from VC, executive search, strategy consulting, investment banking, a high-growth startup, venture building or talent. You don't need to have worked in venture before. What matters is that you can: - Spot exceptional people and develop a strong point of view on their potential. - Understand businesses, markets and what makes founders successful. - Build genuine relationships and influence people to make high-stakes career decisions. - Source talent creatively, particularly people who aren't actively looking. - Operate with limited information, ambiguity and a high degree of autonomy. - Balance instinct with evidence and be willing to change your mind. - Move quickly without compromising your judgement. - Communicate clearly and challenge assumptions when needed. You don't need to be a founder or have a traditional career path. We care more about your judgement, curiosity, ambition and ability to identify exceptional people. WHAT YOU'LL BE MEASURED ON - Founder quality: Exceptional founders joining our ventures. - Founder-market fit: The quality of our decisions around who should build which company. - Speed: Moving from venture thesis to founder commitment quickly. - Founding teams: Helping founders build the teams they need to succeed. - Talent intelligence: Building a proprietary network and understanding of exceptional founders and operators. - Repeatability: Making our approach to talent investing better and more scalable over time. A CAREER IN VENTURE Talent Investing sits at the intersection of people, company building and venture capital. You'll develop an investor's perspective on founders and companies at the earliest possible stage, often before there is a company to invest in. Over time, there is scope to develop into broader venture-building and investment responsibilities acro

jobgether-jobgether:lever:221611a3-1fb4-.title: Marketing Manager – Brand & Organic Growth
jobgether-jobgether:lever:221611a3-1fb4-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Marketing Manager – Brand & Organic Growth based in Germany. This role offers the opportunity to become a highly visible voice for a growing portfolio of digital brands within the iGaming and affiliate marketing space. You will shape brand presence across industry events, conferences, social media, and digital channels. The position combines relationship building, content creation, event marketing, and organic growth initiatives. You will build meaningful connections with industry stakeholders, media, partners, and other influential contacts. Working closely with SEO, content, and affiliate teams, you will turn events and social activity into measurable brand visibility and organic reach. This is a dynamic role for a charismatic marketer who enjoys representing brands publicly and creating opportunities for recognition and growth. Represent the brands at industry events, expos, conferences, networking opportunities, and other relevant gatherings, acting as a confident and engaging public representative. Create original and engaging content, including photos, videos, interviews, stories, and industry insights, to capture event experiences and strengthen digital presence. Plan and publish event-related and industry-focused content across relevant social media platforms to increase engagement and visibility. Build relationships with industry stakeholders, media contacts, partners, and influencers to generate organic mentions, backlinks, social shares, and other brand amplification opportunities. Collaborate with SEO, content, affiliate, and other internal teams to maximize the impact of social media, events, and brand-building initiatives. Proactively identify and pursue speaking engagements, panel discussions, interviews, media opportunities, and other activities that can strengthen brand credibility and industry recognition. Monitor and analyze the performance of social and event initiatives, using insights to improve brand visibility, organic growth, and audience engagement. Stay informed about industry developments, emerging trends, and relevant opportunities that can contribute to stronger brand positioning and organic reach. Requirements 2–5 years of demonstrated marketing experience within the iGaming industry, particularly in roles involving public representation, social media, event marketing, or brand growth. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the charisma and confidence to act as a visible representative at industry events and across digital channels. Proven ability to build and maintain authentic professional relationships and develop a strong industry network organically. Comfortable independently producing engaging social media content, including event coverage, interviews, photos, videos, and short-form stories. Good understanding of digital marketing and fundamental SEO concepts, particularly the role of organic visibility in building brand awareness and authority. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple activities independently while maintaining a high standard of execution. Willingness and ability to travel frequently for conferences, expos, networking events, and other industry activities. Fluent English communication skills; additional languages are considered an advantage. A proactive, adaptable, and commercially minded approach, with the ability to identify opportunities and turn relationships and industry activity into measurable brand impact. Benefits Competitive salary with performance-related bonuses. Additional “refer a friend” bonus opportunities. Diverse career development and growth opportunities. Supportive and collaborative working environment. Flexible work arrangements designed to support work-life balance. Corporate events and opportunities to participate in industry activities. Corporate travel opportunities. Advanced benefits

jobgether-jobgether:lever:b70e3c05-59ab-.title: Records Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:b70e3c05-59ab-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Records Manager based in Germany. This is a flexible, fractional opportunity for an experienced records, compliance, or information governance professional to establish and manage a controlled archive and knowledge-review system. You will play a critical role in determining what information should be preserved, how records are tracked, and what material is ready for entry into a governed knowledge environment. The role combines meticulous records management with responsible use of approved AI tools to accelerate classification and inventory processes. Your judgment will remain central, with every significant AI-assisted decision requiring human verification and careful review. You will work independently, identify risks early, and ensure sensitive information is handled with exceptional discretion. This position is particularly suited to someone who values accuracy, accountability, and strong information governance practices. The engagement is structured as an 8-week pilot with up to 8 hours per week, offering meaningful work without a full-time commitment. Receive, preserve, organize, and track the custody of authorized records and source files throughout the review and archival process. Review incoming information for sensitivity, ownership, completeness, and eligibility for admission into the governed knowledge environment. Use approved AI tools to accelerate information inventory, classification, and review while personally validating all material decisions before they are finalized. Identify and immediately escalate missing, corrupted, incomplete, sensitive, or otherwise high-risk records. Maintain accurate tracking of records, review decisions, outstanding items, and relevant risks. Apply sound professional judgment when determining whether information is suitable for preservation or further review. Provide a concise weekly report covering completed work, remaining backlog, key decisions, and identified risks. Help establish reliable processes and controls for a new or evolving records and knowledge-governance function. Escalate uncertainty or ambiguity rather than making unsupported assumptions, ensuring information is handled consistently and responsibly. Requirements Professional experience in records management, information governance, compliance, audit, legal operations, or a closely related field. Exceptional discretion and demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential or sensitive information responsibly. Strong attention to detail and a high standard for accuracy, documentation, and records integrity. Comfortable working with AI-assisted tools and capable of identifying errors, limitations, or inappropriate recommendations produced by AI. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to document decisions, summarize findings, and communicate risks clearly. Sound judgment and a disciplined approach to escalating uncertainty, inconsistencies, and potential compliance concerns. Ability to work independently and manage responsibilities effectively within a limited-hours engagement. Experience establishing an archive, records-management process, or governance function from the ground up is a plus. Familiarity with legal holds, privacy requirements, cybersecurity practices, or related information governance controls is advantageous. Experience designing human-review controls or quality-assurance processes for AI-assisted workflows is a bonus. A mindset focused on accountability, precision, and preventing unverified information from becoming part of an official knowledge environment. Benefits Fractional contract engagement of up to 8 hours per week. 8-week pilot engagement. Flexible work-from-anywhere arrangement. HMO health insurance. Paid time off. Opportunities for promotion. Potential for pay increases. Opportunity to contribute to the development of a new records and knowled

jobgether-jobgether:lever:d2ac62f2-1e54-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solution Architect — Data & AI Platform based in India. This senior contract opportunity is designed for an experienced architect passionate about the intersection of modern data platforms and artificial intelligence. You will shape AI-ready data capabilities on a modern Databricks Lakehouse foundation, enabling advanced analytics and intelligent applications. The role spans LLM-powered analytics, conversational AI, agentic workflows, governed data products, semantic layers, metadata intelligence, and RAG. You will establish scalable architecture patterns that connect high-quality, governed data with emerging AI capabilities. The position combines strategic architecture leadership with hands-on technical design across data, AI, governance, and platform engineering. Collaborate with engineering, data, AI, and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into practical architecture solutions. Promote modern engineering practices, including automation and CI/CD, to support reliable delivery and continuous improvement of data and AI platforms. Strong experience designing modern data platforms, preferably using Databricks, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog . Solid understanding of lakehouse architecture, data governance, metadata management, data products, and semantic modeling. Practical knowledge of AI/GenAI architecture patterns, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, semantic search, model serving, grounding, and AI evaluation . Experience designing or enabling agentic AI workflows , particularly for data discovery, lineage, quality, documentation, troubleshooting, or platform operations. Strong SQL skills and familiarity with modern data engineering and analytics ecosystems. Experience with CI/CD practices and automation for data and AI platform development and deployment. Ability to design secure and scalable architectures that balance innovation, governance, performance, and maintainability. Strong understanding of data quality, lineage, metadata, business definitions, and governed metrics. labhouse-labhouse:ashbyhq:887d8fd2-ecfd-.title: Staff Software Engineer
labhouse-labhouse:ashbyhq:887d8fd2-ecfd-.description: Labhouse is a Barcelona-based startup studio building AI-powered mobile apps used by hundreds of thousands of people worldwide. Our products — including Invoice Fly and Summary AI — are designed to make everyday tasks faster, smarter, and simpler through a subscription model that puts the user first. We were founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos, the duo behind SocialPoint (acquired by Take-Two Interactive), and we operate with the mindset of a product company: small teams, high ownership, and a relentless focus on building things that matter. Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help us tackle the next stage of growth. A hands-on engineering leader with strong technical depth, the ability to move across technologies, and experience taking products from 0→1 and scaling them from 1→100. You'll work directly with the CTO and own the most complex technical challenges in the company. You can go from architecture discussions in the morning to shipping code in the afternoon and build scalable and reliable systems, and raise the bar across the engineering team. Every stage of growth creates new constraints to solve. If you're motivated by complexity, ownership and speed, you'll likely enjoy this role. ABOUT YOU ACADEMIC BACKGROUND: - Degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related technical field. TECHNICAL EXPERTISE: - Proven experience building and launching entirely new products - Creating engineering systems that allow us to move faster and scale without increasing complexity. - Hands-on experience improving app performance and reliability across millions of users. - Capable of solving the most complex technical challenges in our systems. - Experience migrating critical infrastructure and redesigning core platform services. - Experience with a range of different technologies. Today, that includes technologies such as Flutter, Dart, TypeScript, GCP, SQL, but we don't hire based on specific frameworks. We hire people who can learn quickly and figure things out. PROBLEM-SOLVING AND PRODUCT FOCUS: - Eye for detail and a product-first mindset, with a passion for creating exceptional user experiences. - Self-driven, entrepreneurial attitude with the ability to work autonomously and take ownership of projects. - You enjoy operating in ambiguity. You care about impact more than process. You're comfortable owning outcomes, not just tasks. COMMUNICATION: - Good level of spoken and written English. - Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including design, product, and marketing. WHAT WE OFFER: - Remote work from anywhere in Spain. If you are based in Barcelona, we would love for you to join us at the office (Barcelona Tech City) at least two days a week. - Flexible working hours. - Competitive compensation - High-end equipment for your development. - Permanent contract with competitive compensation. - A young and top entrepreneurial team in a dynamic startup environment. - Opportunity to lead, grow, and take on big challenges. - Work with cutting-edge technologies, including the chance to integrate AI models into new apps. YOU SHOULD KNOW: Labhouse is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. However you identify or whatever your journey to this point, we welcome all candidates to apply for the position that inspires them. Come join us and help us build a company that everyone is proud to be part of.
